title: NRCS SNOTEL and SNOLITE stations, Colorado

limitations: Active stations only, as listed by AWDB on the retrieval date.
AWDB gives elevation in feet and does not state its vertical datum or accuracy.
dataTimeZoneOffsetHours is the fixed UTC offset of the station's hourly timestamps (no daylight time). For every Colorado station it is -8; see docs/methods/snow-sar-incidents.md for the check.
A station measures one point in a clearing. The nearest station is not necessarily representative of alpine, wind-loaded or differently aspected terrain.
Elements list what the station is configured to report; a listed element can still be missing or suspect on any given day.
